description: Capture a URL (or a CSS-selected region) with a headless browser. Use ONLY when the text discusses that page/product/article — the capture is recorded with basis=quotation, not a license, and the credit shows source URL + capture date. Prefer selector/crop over full pages. If target_file is given the PNG is inserted after after_block; otherwise the PNG is written next to nothing and returned as an image.

hide.description: Extra CSS selectors to hide (popups, banners)

selector.description: CSS selector to capture just one region (recommended)

name: screenshot_url
title: Capture a web page as a screenshot (quotation basis)
